info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Inventory Item Creation API
info.description: The Product Inventory Item Creation API enables businesses to efficiently add new products to their inventory. This service is essential for retail and inventory management applications, where managing product availability is crucial. Users can input essential product details, ensuring their records are updated in real-time. Retailers and supply chain managers typically leverage this API to enhance stock levels, streamline operations, and improve product catalog accuracy.

post.summary: Create a new product inventory item for a specific channel.
post.description: This operation allows you to create a new product inventory item that is specific to a particular channel. Make sure to provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully register the item in the inventory.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update product inventory items specific to a channel. Ensure that the payload adheres to the defined schema for product inventory management. The request must include the necessary fields consistent with the operations being performed.
